senses.sense_definition: schade of achteruitgang die langzaam ontstaat door langdurig gebruik of wrijving

examples.text: De monteur controleerde de <w>slijtage</w> aan de remmen voor vertrek.

target_lang_translations.en: The mechanic checked the <w>wear</w> on the brakes before departure.

examples.text: Na jaren van intensief gebruik was normale <w>slijtage</w> goed zichtbaar op de vloer.

target_lang_translations.en: After years of heavy use, normal <w>wear and tear</w> was clearly visible on the floor.

target_lang_definitions.en: damage or deterioration that develops gradually through prolonged use or friction

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: gradual damage or deterioration caused by repeated use or friction
ordinary, expected damage that appears over time with normal use
